title: [web] SkSemaphore is a no-op under -sWASM_WORKERS=1, racing FT_Face
body:
### Summary

In https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/190048 (fixing https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/190039) and https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/191014, `skwasm` enabled `SK_ENABLE_THREADLOCAL_STRIKECACHE` because multithreaded `skwasm` and `wimp` are compiled with `-sWASM_WORKERS=1` (`engine/src/build/config/compiler/BUILD.gn:312`) without `-pthread`, which links single-threaded Emscripten system libraries where POSIX synchronization primitives (`sem_wait`, `pthread_cond_wait`) are no-op stubs.

Making `SkStrikeCache` thread-local did not eliminate shared mutable state between main-thread `$paragraph_layout` and `DedicatedWorker` `_surface_renderPicturesOnWorker`:
- Both threads share the same `SkFontMgr`, `FlutterFontCollection`, and `SkTypeface_FreeType` (`FT_Face` / `FT_Library`) instances in shared `WebAssembly.Memory` (`engine/src/flutter/skwasm/fonts.cc:38-42`).
- Whenever the main thread's thread-local `SkStrike` (during `$paragraph_layout`) and the worker thread's thread-local `SkStrike` (during `_surface_renderPicturesOnWorker`) miss at the same time on the same typeface (for example, when animating layout or `FittedBox` scales), both threads concurrently enter `SkScalerContext_FreeType::generateMetrics` / `generateImage` -> `FT_Load_Glyph` -> `TT_Load_Glyph` on the same non-thread-safe FreeType `FT_Face`.
- In Skia (`SkFontHost_FreeType.cpp`), concurrent `SkScalerContext_FreeType` instances across threads rely on `f_t_mutex()` (`SkMutex`) and `fFaceRec->fFTMutex` (`SkMutex`) — backed by `SkSemaphore` (`third_party/skia/src/base/SkSemaphore.cpp`) — to serialize access to `FT_Library` and `FT_Face`.
- Because `SkSemaphore::osWait()` (`sem_wait`) compiles to a no-op stub (`0` blocking or spinning instructions) in both `skwasm.wasm` (`wasm-function[268]`) and `wimp.wasm` (`wasm-function[302]`), `f_t_mutex().acquire()` returns immediately when contended (`fCount.fetch_sub(1) <= 0`), allowing both threads to mutate `FT_Face` simultaneously.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Build `kevmoo/flutter-wasm-compare` at commit `5c4e80e` with `flutter build web --wasm` (`3.49.0-1.0.pre-171`, engine `1a3d11d5ab1`).
2. Serve `build/web` with `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` and `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` so `skwasm_isMultiThreaded() == true`.
3. Navigate to `?workload=grid&nodes=100&renderer=skwasm` (or `renderer=wimp`, or `nodes=1000`), which animates 100 `GridCell` cards containing `FittedBox` + `Text` paragraphs every frame while the `DedicatedWorker` rasterizes the previous frame.

### Observed Behavior

Across repeated runs on both macOS (Apple M4 Pro, Chrome 146) and Linux (x86_64, Headless Chrome 154), multi-threaded `grid@100` and `grid@1000` intermittently fail in one of two ways (`0` failures in single-threaded `skwasm` or `wimp` across 100+ runs):

1. **Uncaught `RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds` in `$paragraph_layout` -> `FT_Load_Glyph` -> `TT_Load_Simple_Glyph`**:
   Instrumenting worker `postMessage` (`cbId`) and `Runtime.exceptionThrown` via CDP shows that while the `DedicatedWorker` is mid-flight executing `_surface_renderPicturesOnWorker` (`cbId = 23`, dispatched at `t = 1721.6 ms`, completed at `t = 1753.1 ms`), the main UI thread throws at `t = 1731.0 ms`:

```text
RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[2107]:0x63e5b   // TT_Load_Simple_Glyph (FreeType ttgload.c)
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[10931]:0x2863fd // load_truetype_glyph (FreeType ttgload.c)
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[10942]:0x28832c // TT_Load_Glyph (FreeType ttgload.c)
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[721]:0x1f3c1    // FT_Load_Glyph (FreeType ftobjs.c)
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[11471]:0x2a7ee9 // SkScalerContext_FreeType::generateMetrics (calls f_t_mutex() func 452 -> func 268)
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[6734]:0x185fda  // SkScalerContext::makeGlyph
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[1776]:0x51f44   // SkStrike::digestFor
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[2783]:0x8e456   // SkBulkGlyphMetrics::glyph
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[6681]:0x182bb3  // SkBulkGlyphMetrics::glyphs
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[2246]:0x6b813   // SkStrike::lock / glyph metrics
    ...
    at skwasm.wasm:wasm-function[9227]:0x227493  // skia::textlayout::ParagraphImpl::layout
    at $paragraph_layout (skwasm.wasm:0x26ee84)  // engine/src/flutter/skwasm/text/paragraph.cc:55
```

   This uncaught trap aborts `PipelineOwner.flushLayout()` mid-frame and stops all subsequent scene production while `requestAnimationFrame` continues firing.

2. **Main-thread infinite busy-spin in `dlmalloc`**:
   If a thread traps while holding Emscripten's `dlmalloc` spinlock (`wasm-function[276]` / `wasm-function[222]`, spinning on `i32.atomic.rmw.xchg offset=603928`) or concurrent FreeType `FT_Memory` allocations corrupt allocator state, the next main-thread allocation spins indefinitely in `dlmalloc`, hanging the tab.

Disassembling `wasm-function[268]` in `skwasm.wasm` (and identical `wasm-function[302]` in `wimp.wasm`) confirms that `SkSemaphore::wait()` returns immediately without waiting when `fCount.fetch_sub(1) <= 0`:

```wat
(func (;268;) (type 2) (param i32)
  block ;; label = @1
    block ;; label = @2
      local.get 0
      i32.const 1
      i32.atomic.rmw.sub
      i32.const 0
      i32.gt_s
      br_if 0 (;@2;) ;; Uncontended (old fCount > 0): lock acquired, return.
      block ;; label = @3
        block ;; label = @4
          local.get 0
          i32.atomic.load8_u offset=4 ;; SkOnce state (0=NotStarted, 1=Claimed, 2=Done)
          br_table 0 (;@4;) 1 (;@3;) 2 (;@2;) 1 (;@3;)
          ;; When SkOnce == 2 (Done), jumps directly to @2 (return) with zero wait instructions.
        end
        local.get 0
        i32.const 0
        i32.const 1
        i32.atomic.rmw8.cmpxchg_u offset=4
        i32.eqz
        br_if 2 (;@1;)
      end
      loop ;; label = @3
        local.get 0
        i32.atomic.load8_u offset=4
        i32.const 2
        i32.ne
        br_if 0 (;@3;)
      end
    end
    return
  end
  local.get 0
  i32.const 16
  call 224 ;; operator new(16) for OSSemaphore (sem_t)
  i32.store offset=8
  local.get 0
  i32.const 2
  i32.atomic.store8 offset=4
)
```

### Expected Behavior

`SkMutex` / `SkSemaphore` (`third_party/skia/src/base/SkSemaphore.cpp`) must enforce mutual exclusion when compiled with `-sWASM_WORKERS=1` (e.g., via Wasm atomics / spin-wait on the main browser thread and `emscripten_futex_wait` on workers), or `SkTypeface_FreeType` (`FT_Face`) must not be shared across threads without synchronization.

### Environment / Target

- Target Commit / Version: Flutter `3.49.0-1.0.pre-171` (engine `1a3d11d5ab1`, after #190048 and #191014)
- Runtime / Platform: WebAssembly (`skwasm` and `wimp` multi-threaded under COOP/COEP), Chrome 146 (macOS arm64) and Chrome 154 (Linux x86_64)
